ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels represent approximately 95% of the visible surface, with low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated in narrow bands at the trailing edges and lateral tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A vast, continuous high-intensity white field occupies the central 90% of the fluke; low-intensity black pixel clusters form irregular contiguous borders along the distal tips and as a thin, jagged line along the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 62 degrees and a bounding-box depth of roughly 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated boundary with high-frequency variations; pixel amplitudes range from 2 to 8 pixels; most prominent jaggedness is located on the lateral thirds of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate convex curvature defined from the median notch, transitioning to a slight upward hook at the terminal lateral tips.

other_distinctive_markers: Nearly complete absence of dark pigmentation across the interior ventral surface, presenting a highly homogeneous high-intensity pixel field.
